text:
mia: Quick prelaunch SEO checklist for next week's webinar — need keyword map, FAQ schema, internal linking plan, and redirect sweep by EOD Fri. Can we split ownership? :spiral_calendar:

alex: Copy. Can you share the seed keywords?

mia: Seed kws: "llm inference costs", "inference latency optimization", "model serving best practices". Aim 3 tops and 6 longtail variants.

tariq: I can own internal linking. Which pillar pages should we pull from?

mia: From product blog: "Inference runtime", "Cost engineering for inference", and the dedicated capacity announcement. Also two case studies that already rank.

gabi: I’ll take FAQ schema + canonical tags. Prefer 5–7 Qs focused on: pricing, latency, security, private deployment, and integration. I’ll draft JSON-LD.

mia: Example snippet Gabi can expand:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "How does Redwood reduce inference cost?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Adaptive batching, prefix caching, and recommended quantization profiles reduce per-token cost without sacrificing SLAs."
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

seo-bot: Automated check: 3 pages linked from webinar hub missing meta descriptions. Report: https://redwood.tools/seo-report/276543 (run full preflight Fri 09:45).

alex: Redirects — proposed: 301 /old-webinar -> /webinar/benchmarks-2026. Also set canonical on A/B test pages to primary landing. Netlify example:
```toml
[[redirects]]
from = "/old-webinar"
to = "/webinar/benchmarks-2026"
status = 301
```

mia: Tariq, can you apply redirects + internal link changes? Put list in the doc so Gabi can wire schema anchors.

tariq: Yep. I’ll add the internal link list and push the redirect rule today (will target staging).

gabi: I’ll open a PR with the JSON-LD + meta description updates and include sample Qs. Will ping for quick review.

mia: Tracking: use utm_source=webinaremail, utm_campaign=benchmarks2026, utm_medium=organic for promo pages. Hidden form fields must map to SFDC lead_source. Alex can you confirm?

alex: Confirmed — will add hidden fields and QA the flow this afternoon.

mia: Great. Final preflight check Friday 10:00am PT — I’ll drop a calendar invite. Please try to have redirects + schema PRs up by Thursday EOD.

tariq: Sounds good.

gabi: :thumbsup:

seo-bot: Reminder set: SEO preflight job scheduled Fri 09:45am — will post results in this thread.
